d: Radha strives to overcome various challenges in order to save her marriage, along with tackling betrayal and promises which test her resilience.

After bidding farewell to Laddo, Angoori invites Anita and Vibhuti over for dinner. Later, Chuttan, a goon, enters Manmohan's house while he and Angoori are waiting for their neighbours.
Tiwari and Angoori complain to Anita after Vibhuti winks at Angoori, but Vibhuti denies doing so. Later, Angoori approaches Happu to report Vibhuti when he winks at her again.
Happu arrives to arrest Vibhuti after it is proven that he is indeed winking at Angoori. Later, Vibhuti visits a doctor for treatment before informing the commissioner about his illness.
Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari live in the same neighbourhood in Kanpur. They both try to impress each other's wives but end up landing in peculiar situations.
Prem covertly provides food to Vibhuti while Tiwari tries to orchestrate his divorce from Anita with Saxena. Later, Dr Gupta reveals the truth to Anita before Angoori winks at Vibhuti.

Angoori grows dizzy after taking herbal medicine from an alcohol bottle. Later, Vibhuti misinterprets her state and sparks chaos in the neighbourhood.
Stand-up comedians aka 'Mahabalis' deliver performances of hilarious and satirical skits with the help of their battalion of 'Yoddhas'.
Instead of a romance, Saxena ends up writing a terrifying ghost story for Tiwari's upcoming movie. The spooky narration leaves Tiwari so frightened that he starts babbling in Bengali.
Angoori is surprised when Manmohan addresses her as his sister. Meanwhile, a possessed Manmohan slaps Vibhuti for mispronouncing Bengali words.
The Bengali film director possesses Manmohan's body and demands Vibhuti to start rehearsing for his role. Anokhelal Saxena becomes suspicious of Manmohan's behaviour.
Anokhelal Saxena tells Vibhuti and Anita about the mysterious chair which belonged to the Bengali horror film director, Abhineet Mukherjee. He tells them that Manmohan is possessed by the director.
Angoori, Anita and Vibhuti try to find more about Abhineet Mukherjee's past to free Manmohan from his possession. They find his wife, Mishti, who recognizes Vibhuti as Aunindo.
Anita suggests that Vibhuti should pretend to be Aunindo, the original hero of Abhineet's film. She says he should go and meet Manmohan when he is possessed by Abhineet Mukherjee.
Vibhuti visits Angoori's residence to flirt with her, yet he rejoices and colors Tiwari's face after a warning. Consequently, Angoori worries.
Anita's uncle, John Abraham, invites her to Goa with the wish of seeing her get remarried in a church. She shares the news with Vibhuti, refusing his idea to bring their neighbors along.
The neighbors land in Goa, where Happu Singh warns them about a notorious gang of female robbers. Later, Anita and Angoori catch their husbands ogling women by the pool and plot revenge.
A clueless Tiwari and Vibhuti send Saxena to find out why their wives are angry. However, Saxena sides with Anu and Angoori, falsely claiming the women have new boyfriends.
Vibhuti and Tiwari trigger jealousy in their wives, prompting a retaliatory prank. However, an attempt to confront the rivals goes wrong when they target an innocent man.
Vibhuti and Manmohan dance with two girls in order to make their wives jealous. Anita and Angoori also try to dance with their fake boyfriends to counter their husbands.
Anita questions the chief minister about the real development of the state. Manmohan agrees with Anita and the minister appoints him as the CM of the state for thirty days.
Anita becomes Chief Minister Tiwari's secretary. Later, Happu Singh takes over the police commissioner's job, as he gets demoted to a constable's position.
Faced with a terminal diagnosis, Ishwar takes a drastic step to reform his irresponsible son. He casts Aditya out of the family home, hoping the hardship will force him to embrace his duties.
After Vibhuti gets kidnapped by some goons, Anita tells Manmohan to help find him. Manmohan asks Happu Singh to look into the matter.
Vibhuti gets coerced into plotting the Chief Minister's abduction after receiving a grave threat against Angoori. He turns to Tika, Tillu, and Malkhan for help.
Malkhaan and Tillu break into Tiwari's room intending to abduct him. Meanwhile, Angoori disguises herself in her spouse's attire.
Anita ousts Vibhuti when she discovers he squandered their home loan money on gambling. Tiwari and Happu Singh advise her to divorce him, which sparks a fight between the two men.
Sati discovers her true identity and birth purpose. Later, despite Brahma's counsel, Daksh insists on Sati's 'svayamvar' while Vishnu encourages Shiva to embrace Sati's love.
Shiva's teardrops transform into rain, soothing Sati's unrest. Later, he confides in Vishnu about his unfulfilled love for Sati while she awaits him at her 'swayamvar'.
A young Lord Shiva shares a deep bond with his mother, Mahasati Anusuya, and goes on various adventures and vanquishes evil.
After arriving in Hastinapur, Kunti gets down from the chariot and proceeds towards the palace. Later, she tells her sons about the elders and their hundred brothers.
After Anna causes Kashi's death, Kamlakar warns of severe repercussions for those accountable. Eventually, Anna encounters Kashi's spirit.
Anita steals several items from Tiwari's house, including his bracelet. Later, Ammaji scolds Tiwari for losing his bracelet.
